text:
Situation: Hydroxocobalamin has been on the FDA shortage list since 2024-11-04 and remains listed as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 20 units (5.1 days on hand). Corvale General holds 75.3 units (18.7 days on hand). Both sites carry NDC 00591288830 labeled by Actavis Pharma, Inc. with Hikma Farmaceutica (Portugal) S.A. named as the manufacturing plant.

Why (FDA record): FDA first posted the shortage on 2024-11-04 and it has remained current for 24 months. No FDA signal has been posted for the Hikma Farmaceutica (Portugal) S.A. plant associated with our supply.

Our position: Corvale East is critically low. Corvale General has sufficient inventory to support a transfer while maintaining a two-week supply. Xseer Pharmaceuticals product is not on the FDA shortage list today, but its label names no identifiable manufacturing plant.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 19 units from Corvale General to Corvale East — requires pharmacy director approval of the transfer request.
2. Evaluate Xseer Pharmaceuticals as a secondary source — requires buyer approval to initiate purchase.

Not recommended: No other sourcing or allocation changes at this time.
